# Mediterraneo Solar Energías Renovables
**Brand Name:** Mediterraneo Solar Energías Renovables
**Founded:** 2020 by Diego Gonzalez
**Website:** https://www.mediterraneosolar.com
**Description:** A trusted Home and Construction Business specializing in solar energy, HVAC, and electrical installations in Alicante, Spain. With over 120+ installations and a 5/5 customer satisfaction rating on Google Reviews, we deliver quality workmanship and value.

## Core Services
1. **Placas Solares (Solar Panels):** Complete installation, legalization, and maintenance. Saves up to 80% on electricity bills.
2. **Climatización (HVAC):** Highly efficient air conditioning and heating systems.
3. **Electricidad:** Comprehensive electrical services by certified electricians.
